children: HC Wainwright & Co. reiterated their Buy rating on Corcept Therapeutics's stock with a price target of $165.00.
The price target implies an upside of 43.7% from the Sep 17 close of $114.86.
Key takeaways from the analyst note

: Corcept Therapeutics has presented compelling clinical trial results for Relacorilant in combination with nab-paclitaxel, demonstrating improved median progression-free survival (mPFS) and median overall survival (mOS) compared to chemotherapy alone. This strong performance in pivotal studies supports the potential for significant market uptake and revenue generation.

: The recent positive opinion from the EMA's Committee for Medicinal Products for Human Use (CHMP) recommending approval of Relacorilant for the treatment of platinum-resistant ovarian cancer enhances the company's prospects and reinforces investor confidence in its growth trajectory.
